notes: Synthetic scenario for Sprint 2 anomaly detection (robust_zscore, median + MAD). Not the same series as net_sales_series.json's trend fixture -- this one is engineered so the 14-point history alternates 100/90/110 (median=100, MAD=10) and the observed point (150 on the last day) is a clean, deliberate spike. Expected values computed by detectors.robust_zscore directly, not hand-derived, to avoid arithmetic mistakes -- see tests/unit/test_business_state_anomaly.py.
